description: The reference TypeScript constants emitter (spec RFC 0036 section 6 item 2): for each environment, one TypeScript file holding, for each kind read, a type made from the kind's schema and a read-only constant object of the kind's resolved entries, with every member at a secret position left out of both. An adopting repository lists its own kinds in reads, and sets command, owns and the directory option to its own layout.

directory.description: The directory the files are written to, one file <environment>.ts for each environment: a literal relative path, no segment of which begins with . or _, or is node_modules, vendor or testdata in any case. It must lie under the owns glob.
